items.brief: Nasdaq exec backs common EU rules for tokenized securities
items.why: Signals push for harmonized EU framework as exchange seeks DLT licensing.

items.brief: ECB collateral eligibility seen boosting tokenized bond demand
items.why: Central bank collateral rules could drive tokenized bond adoption.

items.brief: Aave Labs launches savings app as balances top $63 million
items.why: Moves savings/stablecoin deposits into an app spanning eight networks.

items.brief: Japan's SBI and SMFG launch Solana venture for stablecoins and tokenization
items.why: Large Japanese financial groups plan stablecoin payment infrastructure and asset tokenization on Solana.

items.brief: BlackRock launches HKD tokenized money market fund with Ant Intl, StanChart as investors
items.why: Adds a fourth currency to BlackRock's tokenized MMF lineup, after USD, EUR and GBP.

items.brief: Fed Governor Waller warns of zombie chains as tokenization grows
items.why: Highlights blockchain governance risk for tokenized assets.

items.brief: Swiss central bank, UBS and SIX study ledger for tokenized settlement
items.why: Explores unifying central bank money, commercial money and securities on one ledger.
